$comment: Ferguson Home runs its own storefront: a React app (Relay/Apollo, react-helmet) that is rendered on the server, so the product, price and specification markup is in the HTML while the gallery and the option widgets are rehydrated by JavaScript; window.__APOLLO_STATE__ carries the catalogue. Product URLs are /<slug>/s<productId>, a ?uid=<variantId> query picks one finish (white, white with WonderGliss, ...) and the canonical link drops that query, so product.url is always the plain product URL. Prices are US dollars: span[data-automation=price] holds the current price and sale items add a 'Was' span.strike with the regular one. Stock is plain text ('92 In Stock') and the Add to Cart button is rendered but disabled until an option is chosen, so neither tells an out-of-stock product apart: availability is not configured. The four specification tables (Dimensions and Measurements, Included Components, Characteristics and Features, Warranty and Product Information) are on the page twice, once for wide screens inside div.db-ns and once for narrow screens inside div.dn-ns; only the wide copy is read, which gives every pair once. The description is the overview paragraph of the Details tab; the two later paragraphs in it are the 'Features:' and 'Specifications:' labels of the bullet lists. Category (/<slug>/c<id>), collection and /blackfriday pages do not match. The site sits behind Akamai bot protection and answers 403 to plain clients. The service does not get past it: fetch.engine is 'duckduckgo' (alternate 'brave', used only on an instance where duckduckgo is off), which never contacts the site and builds the product from the search result, so only title, url and the description snippet come back and price, image and specs are listed in unavailable_fields (md/SEARCH_ENGINE_PROPOSAL.md). Search titles end in ' | Ferguson Home' (title_strip), and a ?uid= variant URL matches the indexed product URL because uid is in ignore_params. On 2026-11-13 DuckDuckGo found this product at rank 1 for 'site:fergusonhome.com duravit 030549 0hole' (testdata/search/duckduckgo/fergusonhome-site-slug.html), while the quoted-URL query found nothing, so site_slug goes first. The selectors below still describe the page and are checked against the saved (curl) Duravit Starck 3 undermount sink page from 2026-11-12; they are used only if the site is switched back to the http engine.
